question: For each port status and device owner (considering only ports whose standard attribute resource type is 'ports' and excluding shared networks where networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' and target_tenant is '*' or '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b'), return the port status, device owner, number of ports, earliest standard attribute updated timestamp, and (for that same port status) the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of allocated IP address string lengths for ports with port security enabled and allocated IP address '10.150.64.113/8', ordered by the coefficient of variation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) descending; additionally, only include (port status, device owner) groups whose port_count is greater than the average port_count across all returned (port status, device owner) groups. Do not return any rounded answers.

prediction.sql:
WITH PortCountsAndEarliestUpdate AS (
  SELECT 
    p.status AS port_status,
    p.device_owner AS device_owner,
    COUNT(p.id) AS port_count,
    MIN(sa.updated_at) AS earliest_standard_attr_update
  FROM ports p
  JOIN standardattributes sa ON sa.id = p.standard_attr_id
  WHERE sa.resource_type = 'ports'
    AND p.network_id NOT IN (
      SELECT nr.object_id 
      FROM networkrbacs nr 
      WHERE nr.action = 'access_as_shared' 
        AND (nr.target_tenant = '*' OR nr.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b')
    )
  GROUP BY p.status, p.device_owner
),
PortStatusIpLengthVariation AS (
  SELECT 
    p.status,
    STDDEV(LENGTH(ia.ip_address)) / NULLIF(AVG(LENGTH(ia.ip_address)), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation
  FROM portsecuritybindings psb
  JOIN ports p ON psb.port_id = p.id
  JOIN ipallocations ia ON p.id = ia.port_id
  WHERE psb.port_security_enabled = 1
    AND ia.ip_address = '10.150.64.113/8'
  GROUP BY p.status
  HAVING AVG(LENGTH(ia.ip_address)) > 0
),
CombinedMetrics AS (
  SELECT 
    pc.port_status,
    pc.device_owner,
    pc.port_count,
    pc.earliest_standard_attr_update,
    pv.coefficient_of_variation
  FROM PortCountsAndEarliestUpdate pc
  JOIN PortStatusIpLengthVariation pv ON pv.status = pc.port_status
)
SELECT 
  port_status,
  device_owner,
  port_count,
  earliest_standard_attr_update,
  coefficient_of_variation
FROM CombinedMetrics
WHERE port_count > (SELECT AVG(port_count) FROM CombinedMetrics)
ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC

WITH PortCountsAndEarliestUpdate AS (
  SELECT 
    p.status AS port_status,
    p.device_owner AS device_owner,
    COUNT(p.id) AS port_count,
    MIN(sa.updated_at) AS earliest_standard_attr_update
  FROM ports p
  JOIN standardattributes sa ON sa.id = p.standard_attr_id
  WHERE sa.resource_type = 'ports'
    AND p.network_id NOT IN (
      SELECT nr.object_id 
      FROM networkrbacs nr 
      WHERE nr.action = 'access_as_shared' 
        AND (nr.target_tenant = '*' OR nr.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b')
    )
  GROUP BY p.status, p.device_owner
),
PortStatusIpLengthVariation AS (
  SELECT 
    p.status,
    STDDEV(LENGTH(ia.ip_address)) / NULLIF(AVG(LENGTH(ia.ip_address)), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation
  FROM portsecuritybindings psb
  JOIN ports p ON psb.port_id = p.id
  JOIN ipallocations ia ON p.id = ia.port_id
  WHERE psb.port_security_enabled = 1
    AND ia.ip_address = '10.150.64.113/8'
  GROUP BY p.status
  HAVING AVG(LENGTH(ia.ip_address)) > 0
),
CombinedMetrics AS (
  SELECT 
    pc.port_status,
    pc.device_owner,
    pc.port_count,
    pc.earliest_standard_attr_update,
    pv.coefficient_of_variation
  FROM PortCountsAndEarliestUpdate pc
  JOIN PortStatusIpLengthVariation pv ON pv.status = pc.port_status
)
SELECT 
  port_status,
  device_owner,
  port_count,
  earliest_standard_attr_update,
  coefficient_of_variation
FROM CombinedMetrics
WHERE port_count > (SELECT AVG(port_count) FROM CombinedMetrics)
ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC

       MIN(sa.updated_at) AS earliest_updated,
       (SELECT STDDEV(LENGTH(i.ip_address)) / AVG(LENGTH(i.ip_address))
        FROM ports p2
        JOIN portsecuritybindings psb ON psb.port_id = p2.id
        JOIN ipallocations i ON i.port_id = p2.id
        WHERE p2.status = p.status
          AND psb.port_security_enabled = 1
          AND i.ip_address = '10.150.64.113/8') AS cv
FROM ports p
JOIN standardattributes sa ON sa.id = p.standard_attr_id
WHERE sa.resource_type = 'ports'
  AND p.network_id NOT IN (
      SELECT object_id FROM networkrbacs
      WHERE action = 'access_as_shared'
        AND target_tenant IN ('*', '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b')
  )
GROUP BY p.status, p.device_owner
HAVING port_count > (
    SELECT AVG(cnt) FROM (
        SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt
        FROM ports p3
        JOIN standardattributes sa3 ON sa3.id = p3.standard_attr_id
        WHERE sa3.resource_type = 'ports'
          AND p3.network_id NOT IN (
              SELECT object_id FROM networkrbacs
              WHERE action = 'access_as_shared'
                AND target_tenant IN ('*', '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b')
          )
        GROUP BY p3.status, p3.device_owner
    ) t
)
ORDER BY cv DESC;
